title: প্রাইভেসি পলিসি
content:
Culinary Academy – Culinary Academy-এ আমরা আপনার গোপনীয়তাকে গুরুত্ব দিই এবং আপনার ব্যক্তিগত তথ্য রক্ষা করতে প্রতিশ্রুতিবদ্ধ। এই প্রাইভেসি পলিসি রূপরেখা দেয় কিভাবে আমরা আপনার তথ্য সংগ্রহ করি, ব্যবহার করি এবং সুরক্ষা করি।

1. Information We Collect

We may collect the following information when you fill out a form, register for a course, or browse our website:

  • Full Name
  • Email Address
  • Phone Number
  • Address (if applicable)
  • Any information voluntarily submitted via forms or messages

2. How We Use Your Information

Your information is used to:

  • Process admissions and course enrollments
  • Communicate important updates and schedules
  • Provide customer support
  • Improve our courses, services, and website
  • Send occasional promotional or informational content (only with your consent)

3. Data Protection

We use industry-standard measures to protect your personal data from unauthorized access, disclosure, or misuse. However, no method of transmission over the internet is 100% secure.

4. Third-Party Sharing

We do not sell, trade, or rent your personal information to others. We may share your data with trusted partners only when necessary for certification, payment processing, or official collaboration purposes (e.g., ISO certification).

5. Cookies

Our website may use cookies to enhance user experience and gather analytics. You can control cookie preferences through your browser settings.

6. Your Rights

You have the right to:

  • Access the data we hold about you
  • Request corrections or deletions
  • Withdraw consent for future communications

To do so, contact us at info@culinaryacademy.com.

7. Changes to This Policy

We may update this Privacy Policy periodically. Any changes will be posted on this page with a revised update date.
